def _relative_recency(seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    valid = seq != 0
    counts = valid.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)
    ranks = (valid.long().cumsum(dim=1) - 1).clamp_min(0).float()

    recency = torch.where(counts == 1, torch.ones_like(recency), recency)
